title: Generated BLKREFS adapter output and readback control
scope: Close the generated positive adapter-output gap for BLOCK_RECORD.insertHandles while keeping physical source membership, producer semantics, and whole-document support separate.

generatedGraph.sourceRoute: Locally authored in-memory DWG-origin dx_data; no DWG/DXF fixture is written to the repository.
generatedGraph.blockRecord: One named BLOCK_RECORD has one BLKREFS source handle naming the selected INSERT.
generatedGraph.blockClosure: The selected block definition has BLOCK and ENDBLK identities; the INSERT refers to the unique named target BLOCK_RECORD.
generatedGraph.ownerProfile: Source INSERT uses the documented ownerless ModelSpace context; output readback resolves its owner to the emitted ModelSpace BLOCK_RECORD.
generatedGraph.readback: Fresh DXF readback requires one target BLOCK_RECORD, one matching INSERT, exactly one insertHandles entry equal to the emitted INSERT handle, and ModelSpace ownership.

failureAndRetry.invalidSource: An unknown INSERT owner is refused with the preseeded destination unchanged.
failureAndRetry.retry: Correcting the same source to the permitted ownerless ModelSpace profile succeeds on the same dx_iface instance for both encodings.
failureAndRetry.limitation: The control does not exercise arbitrary named-block owner profiles, source-authored membership completeness, or native BLKREFS meaning.

remaining: Physical-source selected output/readback and complete producer-backed BLKREFS membership remain open. Autodesk’s published BLOCK_RECORD field table does not enumerate BLKREFS; group-331 classification and this generated transport control do not establish application semantics. Keep whole-document support claims closed.
